name: Move to Microsoft 365
result: Old server retired, files on any device
alt: Server, laptop and phone syncing to a cloud workspace hub
story: Files lived on an ageing server in a closet. We moved email and files to Microsoft 365, cleaned up licences, and set up Teams so staff could work from anywhere.

challenge: An accounting firm of 25 people kept every file on a server in a closet. It was eight years old and out of warranty, and working from home meant a slow VPN.
Licences had been bought over the years by different people. Some staff had two, and some ex-staff still had one.

steps.title: Map the files
steps.detail: We sorted client folders, templates and archives, and agreed who needs what.

steps.title: Clean up licences
steps.detail: One licence per person, at the level they actually use.

steps.title: Move over a weekend
steps.detail: Email and files moved to Microsoft 365, with SharePoint sites for each team.

steps.title: Teams and training
steps.detail: Teams set up for calls and chat, with a short session for staff on Monday.

results: The old server is retired, and files open on any device.
Licence costs dropped by about a fifth.
Staff work from home without the VPN.
